Thanks for the draft. I made a few edits to the guest list (attached) and annotated the contract where I think Legal will push back. High-level notes:
- Guest list v2: moved two folks to "priority RSVP" (they're Aurora execs who need a private arrival). See column H for parking notes.
- Legal concerns:

  * Photo & data handling: venue wants to use event photos for promotion; need explicit opt-in and a prohibition on sharing guest emails with third parties.
  * Cancellation: 50% within 30 days is steep — ask for sliding scale (25% within 14 days, 50% 7–13 days, 75% <7 days).

I'm attaching guest_list_v2.csv and a quick redline summary (redlines_aurorahall.docx). If we confirm these asks, I can route to Legal (laura) for a formal redline and then to the venue.

Subject: Aurora Hall — contract & catering options

Hi Ava (and Redwood team),

Thanks for sending the draft. Attached are: AuroraHall_contract_final_for_review.pdf (with our standard annotations) and catering_options_menu.pdf. A few clarifications from our side:

- Insurance: We require a certificate of general liability naming Aurora Hall and Redwood as additional insured for the event. Minimum coverage $1M.
- Cancellation: Our standard is 50% within 30 days. We can be flexible depending on day-of-week and time of year; I can propose a sliding scale if you prefer.
- Photos & marketing: We request permission to use non-identifiable photos for venue promotion. For any identifiable people we require signed releases — we can provide a simple release form at check-in.
- AV & staging: We have an in-house AV package (listed in the attachment). If you bring third-party AV the venue requires a tech routing sheet 7 days prior.
- Guest list: We do not share guest lists with third parties, per our privacy policy, but we do keep a list for fire marshal and security checks.

If you can send a list of required contract redlines (or a DocuSign-ready redline), I'll get this to our contracts team. Also: would you like us to source the caterer (we have preferred vendors including Blue Apron Events)?

Best,
Emily Rhodes
Director of Events | Aurora Hall
emily.rhodes@aurorahall.com
(203) 555-0147

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rhodes <emily.rhodes@aurorahall.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora Hall — contract & catering options

Emily —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. We want to keep this moving, so here's what we'll need from the venue to proceed:

1) DocuSign-ready contract with the following redlines incorporated:
   - Limit Redwood indemnity to direct damages and cap at $1,000,000. Remove any obligation to indemnify for Aurora Health's own acts.
   - Data/photo clause: venue may use non-identifiable photos for promotion; any use of attendee names or emails requires explicit opt-in from each guest. Venue cannot share guest emails with any third party.
   - Cancellation: propose a sliding scale as suggested by Marissa (25% 14–30 days, 50% 7–13 days, 75% <7 days).
   - Add HIPAA carveout: if any Aurora Health attendee shares PHI during the event, venue acknowledges it is not a covered entity and agrees to follow reasonable handling instructions from Aurora.

2) Insurance certificate template and the additional insured language you require so our insurance broker can prepare the COI.

3) Catering: yes, please propose Blue Apron Events as preferred vendor and include vegetarian + severe nut-allergy labeling on the menu. We will provide dietary tags at check-in.

4) Guest list handling: add explicit language that venue will not distribute guest emails outside of emergency/security use and will destroy the list within 30 days after the event unless Redwood/ Aurora instruct otherwise.

Marissa & Laura — I'm routing to Legal now. Laura, can you confirm whether the HIPAA carveout language below is acceptable or if you want different phrasing?

If we can get a DocuSign link with those redlines by Friday 10/23 I can circulate to Aurora Health for final RSVP confirmation.

Thanks,
Ava
Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
